decisions.reason: The existing message-785 MODIFY already replaces automatic prize-payout wording in both relevant FAQ sections with manual redemption through a claim control visible only during the eligibility window.
The landing-page state does not specify automatic prize payout or the visibility behavior of the redemption control, so its current copy and layout requirements remain valid unchanged.
The prize-claim decision has no effect on the landing-page book cover's placement, cropping, visibility, or size.
The candidate already has a complete message-785 MODIFY establishing manual redemption and eligibility-window-only claim-control visibility.
The prize-claim decision does not alter the current or planned product names.
Changing prize redemption from automatic payout to a conditional claim control does not alter email authentication or dashboard-access methods.
Winner email notification and guidance remain valid; the source does not necessarily change email delivery, contents, or channels.
The source distinguishes commissions as independently automatic rewards, so the no-referral commission allocation behavior remains unchanged.
The claim-control decision does not alter Transak payment methods, wallet provisioning, conversion, or mint destination behavior.
Prize-claim control behavior is independent of NFT-holder eligibility and Lit Protocol book-access enforcement.
Manual prize redemption does not change how tickets are generated or assigned for purchases without a referral code.
The prize-claim decision does not modify SIWE, supported user paths, or protected wallet-authentication flows.
